tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Fully nonlinear PDE on a half-space] ↗ thm:characteristic-ode-structure 1. ch3:3.2-ex-3\group Method of Characteristics

The problem \[ u_{x_1}u_{x_2}=u\quad (x_1>0),\qquad u(0,x_2)=x_2^2 \] has the characteristic solution \[ u(x_1,x_2)=\frac{(x_1+4x_2)^2}{16}. \] \end{example}
